description:
**Storno** a posted journal entry: post its mirror image (accountant role).

Nothing is deleted; the original stays, linked, and the **reversal** is returned.
The only VAT-correct storno door — VAT postings, open items and what the document
spawned are unwound.

``body.posting_date`` dates the reversal and decides its period; omitted, it reuses
the original's (a cash register entry: today, inside its year). A closed-period entry
needs one in an open period: the reversal is booked there; the entry stays unchanged.
That correction is a person's act: an API key may make it, and ``warnings`` then carries
``warning.personOnlyActByAgent``.

**409** when: the entry is a reversal or already corrected; a payroll run holds it; the date
falls in a filed VAT period; an open item still carries a live settlement; the target period
is closed or sealed; or a closed-period entry cannot be corrected (the reason is named). A
closed-period entry armed to reverse itself is left to the auto-reversal run (nightly, or
``POST …/gl/auto-reversals/run`` by a person): ``conflict.closedPeriodEntryAutoReverses``.
name: reverse_gl_journal_entry
